name: pwd
description: Prints the current working directory path

name: ls
description: Lists files and directories in current folder

name: mkdir
description: Creates a new folder or directory

name: touch
description: Creates a new empty file or updates timestamp

name: cat
description: Displays the full content of a text file

name: cp
description: Copies files and directories from source to destination

name: chmod
description: Changes read, write, and execute permissions of a file

name: chown
description: Changes the owner and group ownership of a file

name: ping
description: Tests network connectivity to a host or IP address

name: curl
description: Transfers data to or from a server using HTTP/HTTPS

name: netstat
description: Displays active network connections and listening ports

name: ps aux
description: Lists all currently running processes in the system

name: top
description: Real-time interactive process viewer and CPU/RAM monitor

name: kill
description: Terminates a process by its Process ID (PID)

name: git status
description: Shows the state of the working directory and staging area

name: git commit
description: Records staged snapshots to the repository history

name: git push
description: Uploads local branch commits to the remote repository
